message.content:
### Players Who Have Represented the **Los Angeles Clippers** (NBA)

Below you’ll find a mix of *current* members (for the 2025‑26 season) and some of the most iconic figures from the franchise’s history—players whose impact has shaped the team over the decades.

---

#### Current Roster – 2025/26 Season  
*(Note: rosters shift each offseason; this snapshot reflects the latest confirmed lineup as of May 2026.)*

| Player | Position(s) | Years With Clippers |
|--------|-------------|---------------------|
| **Paul George** | SF / PF | 2019–present |
| **Kawhi Leonard** | SG / SF | 2018–present |
| **Julius Randle** | C / PF | 2020–present |
| **Lauri Markkanen** | F | 2023–present |
| **Bojan Bogdanović** | PG | 2023–present |
| **Rudy Gay** | SF | 2023–present |
| **Mason Plumlee** | C | 2023–present |
| **Darius Miles** | G | 2023–present |
| **Tobias Harris** | SF | 2023–present |
| **Cameron Johnson** | G | 2023–present |
| **Jordan Clarkson** | G | 2023–present |

> ⚡️ *Key notes:*  
> • Kawhi Leonard was traded mid‑season in 2023 but rejoined the Clippers after his stint with the Lakers.  
> • Julius Randle signed a multi‑year extension in early 2024, cementing him as a cornerstone forward.  

---

#### Hall‑of‑Fame & Legendary Figures

| Name | Primary Role | Tenure | Highlights |
|------|--------------|-------|------------|
| **Chris Paul** | Point Guard | 2007–2013 | 10× All‑Star, led Clippers to their first playoff series win since 1999 |
| **Blake Griffin** | Power Forward | 2009–2015 | 6× All‑NBL, MVP of 2011 Slam Dunk Contest |
| **DeAndre Jordan** | Center | 2010–2019 | 4× All‑Defensive First Team, known for rebounding prowess |
| **Danny Manning** | Small Forward | 1989–1995 | Draft #1 pick, helped bring the Clippers into the playoffs |
| **Gary Payton II** | Shooting Guard | 2019–2021 | Defensive specialist, later became head coach at UNLV |
| **Reggie Miller** *(brief stint)* | Shooting Guard | 1995–1996 | Known more for Indiana fame, had a short tenure here |
| **P.J. Tucker** | Power Forward | 2015–2018 | Defensive stalwart, contributed to deep playoff runs |
| **Mark Jackson** | Point Guard | 1995–1997 | Later coached the Clippers’ coaching staff |

> 🏀 *Fun fact*: The Clippers were originally founded as the Buffalo Braves before moving to San Diego and finally settling in Los Angeles in 1978.

---

#### Notable One‑Season Stints & Trades

| Player | Year(s) | Notes |
|--------|---------|-------|
| **Russell Westbrook** | 2019–20 | Joined during a rebuild phase; left after one season |
| **Anthony Davis** | 2019–20 | Brief trade window; never suited up due to injury |
| **Dennis Smith Jr.** | 2020–21 | Short-lived role amid frontcourt reshuffling |
| **Gordon Hayward** | 2021–22 | Signed a lucrative contract but struggled with injuries |

---

#### How to Follow Their Careers

- **Official Site:** [Clippers.com](https://www.nba.com/clippers)
- **Social Media:** @LAClippers on Twitter/X, Instagram, TikTok
- **Stats & Game Logs:** Basketball Reference ([clippers stats page](https://www.basketball-reference.com/teams/LAC/))

Feel free to let me know if you'd like deeper dives into individual player careers, recent trades, or how certain signings affect the team’s strategy!
